newsitem.title: DUBAI: Quake measuring 4.6 degrees jolts Iran city.
newsitem.headline: Quake measuring 4.6 degrees jolts Iran city.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 4.6 degrees on the Richter scale rocked the city of Zahedan in southeast Iran on Tuesday, but there were no immediate reports of casualties, the official news agency IRNA said.
It said an aftershock jolted the city a few minutes after the 0211 GMT quake.
It did not mention any possible damage to the city, the capital of Sistan Baluchistan province. The province's population is about one million people.
The city is close to the borders with Pakistan and Afghanistan.
